system.scope: Leading-edge (≤5 nm) semiconductor patterning — production of the EUV lithography scanner

control_mechanism.statement: Sole present productive capacity for the EUV lithography scanner — the exposure tool a primary U.S. government review states is essential for producing integrated circuits at ≤5 nm and is produced by only one supplier — with the EUV light source vertically integrated into the same producer.

locus.statement: EUV scanner production (manufacture of the complete EUV stepper/scanner system)

evidence_bindings.claim: Sole production of EUV scanners essential for ≤5 nm patterning
evidence_bindings.source: White House / Dept. of Commerce, 100-Day Reviews under EO 14017, June 2021, p. 51
evidence_bindings.fact: for lithography, ASML (Netherlands) is the sole producer of EUV stepper/scanners, which are essential for producing integrated circuits with a linewidth of 5 nm or less.

evidence_bindings.claim: Only ASML supplies EUV equipment (contrasted with broader lithography oligopoly)
evidence_bindings.source: White House / Dept. of Commerce, 100-Day Reviews under EO 14017, June 2021, p. 54
evidence_bindings.fact: only ASML supplies EUV equipment, and the top three providers (ASML, Nikon, Canon) account for virtually all of the overall market share.

evidence_bindings.claim: EUV light-source capacity is vertically integrated into the scanner producer
evidence_bindings.source: White House / Dept. of Commerce, 100-Day Reviews under EO 14017, June 2021, p. 50
evidence_bindings.fact: Cymer produces the lasers (light source) for ASML's EUV stepper/scanner machines; ASML acquired Cymer in 2013; Cymer remains a separate operating unit within ASML.

evidence_bindings.claim: Sole essential presently-unsubstitutable productive capacity is a capacity chokepoint
evidence_bindings.fact: Sole production of the EUV scanner + that scanner being essential for ≤5 nm patterning + light source vertically integrated.
evidence_bindings.derivation: Mechanical conjunction of S0 sole-production and essentiality facts under the frozen capacity_control definition yields a capacity chokepoint label; no domain judgment required.

claim_boundary.admissible: Within leading-edge (≤5 nm) semiconductor patterning, a capacity_control layer sits at EUV scanner production: a primary U.S. government review states that ASML is the sole producer of EUV stepper/scanners essential for ≤5 nm linewidths, with no present alternative supplier and the EUV light source vertically integrated into the same producer.
excluded: Any claim of permanence / future unbypassability.
